title.en: CapCut downloaded materials and app data
title.zh: CapCut 下载的素材和应用数据

explain.en: Effects, music, text templates and online materials CapCut downloaded, plus its own material index, cloud-draft data, AI material records and cache folder. Your drafts point at some of these files, material no longer offered online may not come back, and some may be things you made in CapCut, so Hoardless only shows the size.
explain.zh: CapCut 下载的特效、音乐、文字模板和在线素材，以及 CapCut 自己的素材索引、云草稿数据、AI 素材记录和缓存文件夹。你的草稿直接引用其中一些文件，已下架的素材删了可能找不回来，有些还可能是你在 CapCut 里生成的内容，所以只显示大小。

evidence.note: CapCut 9.5.0 (com.lemon.lvoverseas) on the maintainer's Mac: inside ~/Movies/CapCut/User Data/Cache, effect 1.37 GB, ressdk_db 0.46 GB (SQLite), music 0.24 GB, onlineMaterial 0.06 GB, AigcMaterailCache 0.06 GB, artistEffect 0.02 GB, AITextTemplate and cloudDraft 0.01 GB each; ~/Library/Caches/com.lemon.lvoverseas absent. macOS 26.6.2.

notes: The CapCut help page names ~/Library/Caches/com.lemon.lvoverseas; the ~/Movies paths are from local observation only. CapCut's globalSetting has no cache-location key, so a moved cache is not followed. Folders the app rebuilds are in capcut-generated-cache. Not covered: about 45 Cache subfolders under 5 MB (about 17 MB together) and loose files. Not tested, on purpose: removing these could make an autosaved draft lose a template or material.
